scripts.test:unit: for d in mods/*/unit-tests; do m="${d%/unit-tests}"; for f in "$d"/test_*.lua; do echo "# $f" && (cd "$m" && lua "unit-tests/$(basename "$f")") || exit 1; done; done
scripts.test:unit:py: for d in mods/*/unit-tests; do for f in "$d"/test_*.py; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "# $f" && python3 "$f" || exit 1; done; done
scripts.test:play: bash tests/play-sh.test.sh && bash tests/play-patchelf.test.sh && bash tests/test-unit-py.test.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:unit:py && npm run test:play && npm run test:integration
